mapper.sql: latest_candidate_trade_date as ( select coalesce(#{tradeDate}, max(cp.trade_date)) as trade_date from market_indicator_candidate_pool cp where cp.deleted_at is null and exists ( select 1 from market_indicator_snapshots s where s.deleted_at is null and s.trade_date = cp.trade_date and s.captured_at = cp.captured_at and s.last_price > 0 ) ), latest_candidate_capture as ( select max(cp.captured_at) as captured_at from market_indicator_candidate_pool cp join latest_candidate_trade_date d on d.trade_date = cp.trade_date where cp.deleted_at is null and exists ( select 1 from market_indicator_snapshots s where s.deleted_at is null and s.trade_date = cp.trade_date and s.captured_at = cp.captured_at and s.last_price > 0 ) ), candidate_codes as ( select distinct cp.code from market_indicator_candidate_pool cp join latest_candidate_trade_date d on d.trade_date = cp.trade_date join latest_candidate_capture c on c.captured_at = cp.captured_at where cp.deleted_at is null and exists ( select 1 from market_indicator_snapshots s where s.deleted_at is null and s.code = cp.code and s.trade_date = cp.trade_date and s.captured_at = cp.captured_at and s.last_price > 0 ) )

latest_ths_date as ( select max(snapshot_date) as snapshot_date from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot where deleted_at is null ), ths_mapping as ( select distinct on (ths_code) ths_code, ths_name, tdx_code6, tdx_name, confidence, priority from tdx_ths_industry_mapping where deleted_at is null order by ths_code, is_primary desc nulls last, priority asc nulls last, confidence desc nulls last, tdx_code6 ), ths_membership as ( select distinct on (s.stock_code) s.stock_code as code, s.industry_code as ths_code, m.ths_name, m.tdx_code6, m.tdx_name, m.confidence from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot s join latest_ths_date d on d.snapshot_date = s.snapshot_date left join ths_mapping m on m.ths_code = s.industry_code where s.deleted_at is null and s.stock_code is not null and s.stock_code <> '' order by s.stock_code, s.rank nulls last, s.industry_code )
mapper.select: with , , latest as ( select distinct on (s.code) s.id, s.code, s.name, s.market, s.last_price, s.prev_close, s.open_price, s.high_price, s.low_price, change_pct, amount, volume, turnover_rate, limit_up_price, limit_down_price, limit_status, source, s.captured_at from market_indicator_snapshots s join candidate_codes cp on cp.code = s.code join latest_candidate_capture c on c.captured_at = s.captured_at where s.deleted_at is null and s.last_price > 0 and (s.change_pct is null or s.change_pct > -99.99) order by s.code ) select latest.id, latest.code, latest.name, coalesce(ths_membership.ths_name, '未分类') as industry, latest.market, latest.last_price, latest.prev_close, latest.open_price, latest.high_price, latest.low_price, latest.change_pct, latest.amount, latest.volume, latest.turnover_rate, latest.limit_up_price, latest.limit_down_price, latest.limit_status, latest.source, latest.captured_at from latest left join ths_membership on ths_membership.code = latest.code where limit_status = #{status} order by latest.captured_at desc, latest.code limit #{limit}

with select e.id, e.trade_date, e.code, e.name, e.market, e.event_type, e.event_at, e.signal_value, e.last_price, e.change_pct, e.limit_status, e.source from market_indicator_events e join candidate_codes cp on cp.code = e.code where e.deleted_at is null and e.last_price > 0 and e.change_pct > -99.99 and e.trade_date = (select trade_date from latest_candidate_trade_date) and event_type = #{eventType} order by event_at desc limit #{limit}

with , , latest as ( select distinct on (s.code) s.change_pct, s.limit_status, s.captured_at from market_indicator_snapshots s join candidate_codes cp on cp.code = s.code join latest_candidate_capture c on c.captured_at = s.captured_at where s.deleted_at is null and s.last_price > 0 and (s.change_pct is null or s.change_pct > -99.99) order by s.code ), events as ( select count(*) filter (where event_type = 'rapid_rise')::int as rapid_rise_count, count(*) filter (where event_type = 'rapid_fall')::int as rapid_fall_count from market_indicator_events e join candidate_codes cp on cp.code = e.code where e.deleted_at is null and e.trade_date = (select trade_date from latest_candidate_trade_date) ) select count(*)::int as total_count, count(*) filter (where change_pct > 0)::int as advancing_count, count(*) filter (where change_pct < 0)::int as declining_count, count(*) filter (where change_pct is null or change_pct = 0)::int as flat_count, count(*) filter (where limit_status = 'limit_up_sealed')::int as limit_up_count, count(*) filter (where limit_status = 'limit_up_touch')::int as limit_up_touch_count, count(*) filter (where limit_status = 'limit_down_sealed')::int as limit_down_count, count(*) filter (where limit_status = 'limit_down_touch')::int as limit_down_touch_count, max(captured_at) as captured_at, max(events.rapid_rise_count) as rapid_rise_count, max(events.rapid_fall_count) as rapid_fall_count from latest cross join events

with , , latest as ( select distinct on (industry_name) id, trade_date, captured_at, industry_code, industry_name, stock_count, advancing_count, declining_count, flat_count, limit_up_count, limit_up_touch_count, limit_down_count, limit_down_touch_count, rapid_rise_count, rapid_fall_count, first_limit_up_at, first_limit_up_code, first_limit_up_name, first_limit_up_change_pct, first_event_at, first_event_code, first_event_name, first_event_type, first_event_signal_value, source from market_indicator_industry_snapshots where deleted_at is null and trade_date = (select trade_date from latest_candidate_trade_date) and captured_at = (select captured_at from latest_candidate_capture) order by industry_name, captured_at desc ), first_limit as ( select distinct on (m.ths_name) m.ths_name as industry_name, e.event_at as first_limit_up_at, e.code as first_limit_up_code, e.name as first_limit_up_name, e.change_pct as first_limit_up_change_pct from market_indicator_events e join candidate_codes cp on cp.code = e.code join ths_membership m on m.code = e.code where e.deleted_at is null and e.trade_date = (select trade_date from latest_candidate_trade_date) and e.event_type in ('limit_up_touch', 'limit_up_sealed') order by m.ths_name, e.event_at, e.code ), first_event as ( select distinct on (m.ths_name) m.ths_name as industry_name, e.event_at as first_event_at, e.code as first_event_code, e.name as first_event_name, e.event_type as first_event_type, e.signal_value as first_event_signal_value from market_indicator_events e join candidate_codes cp on cp.code = e.code join ths_membership m on m.code = e.code where e.deleted_at is null and e.trade_date = (select trade_date from latest_candidate_trade_date) order by m.ths_name, e.event_at, e.code ) select latest.id, latest.trade_date, latest.captured_at, latest.industry_code, latest.industry_name, latest.stock_count, latest.advancing_count, latest.declining_count, latest.flat_count, latest.limit_up_count, latest.limit_up_touch_count, latest.limit_down_count, latest.limit_down_touch_count, latest.rapid_rise_count, latest.rapid_fall_count, coalesce(first_limit.first_limit_up_at, latest.first_limit_up_at) as first_limit_up_at, coalesce(first_limit.first_limit_up_code, latest.first_limit_up_code) as first_limit_up_code, coalesce(first_limit.first_limit_up_name, latest.first_limit_up_name) as first_limit_up_name, coalesce(first_limit.first_limit_up_change_pct, latest.first_limit_up_change_pct) as first_limit_up_change_pct, coalesce(first_event.first_event_at, latest.first_event_at) as first_event_at, coalesce(first_event.first_event_code, latest.first_event_code) as first_event_code, coalesce(first_event.first_event_name, latest.first_event_name) as first_event_name, coalesce(first_event.first_event_type, latest.first_event_type) as first_event_type, coalesce(first_event.first_event_signal_value, latest.first_event_signal_value) as first_event_signal_value, latest.source from latest left join first_limit on first_limit.industry_name = latest.industry_name left join first_event on first_event.industry_name = latest.industry_name order by limit_up_count desc, rapid_rise_count desc, declining_count desc, industry_name limit #{limit}

with , , latest as ( select distinct on (s.code) s.id, s.code, s.name, s.market, s.last_price, s.prev_close, s.open_price, s.high_price, s.low_price, change_pct, amount, volume, turnover_rate, limit_up_price, limit_down_price, limit_status, source, s.captured_at from market_indicator_snapshots s join candidate_codes cp on cp.code = s.code join latest_candidate_capture c on c.captured_at = s.captured_at where s.deleted_at is null and s.last_price > 0 and (s.change_pct is null or s.change_pct > -99.99) order by s.code ) select latest.id, latest.code, latest.name, coalesce(ths_membership.ths_name, '未分类') as industry, latest.market, latest.last_price, latest.prev_close, latest.open_price, latest.high_price, latest.low_price, latest.change_pct, latest.amount, latest.volume, latest.turnover_rate, latest.limit_up_price, latest.limit_down_price, latest.limit_status, latest.source, latest.captured_at from latest join candidate_codes cp on cp.code = latest.code join ths_membership on ths_membership.code = latest.code where ths_membership.ths_code = #{industryCode} order by abs(latest.change_pct) desc nulls last, latest.code offset #{offset} limit #{limit}

with , , latest as ( select distinct on (s.code) s.code, s.change_pct, s.captured_at from market_indicator_snapshots s join candidate_codes cp on cp.code = s.code join latest_candidate_capture c on c.captured_at = s.captured_at where s.deleted_at is null and s.last_price > 0 and (s.change_pct is null or s.change_pct > -99.99) order by s.code ) select ths_mapping.ths_code as industry_code, ths_mapping.ths_name as industry_name, 'THS90' as category_label, count(distinct latest.code)::int as total_count, count(*) filter (where latest.change_pct > 0)::int as advancing_count, count(*) filter (where latest.change_pct < 0)::int as declining_count, count(*) filter (where latest.change_pct is null or latest.change_pct = 0)::int as flat_count, round(avg(latest.change_pct), 2) as average_change_pct, max(latest.captured_at) as captured_at from ths_mapping join ths_membership membership on membership.ths_code = ths_mapping.ths_code join latest on latest.code = membership.code where ths_mapping.ths_code = #{industryCode} group by ths_mapping.ths_code, ths_mapping.ths_name

with , , latest as ( select distinct on (s.code) s.code, s.change_pct from market_indicator_snapshots s join candidate_codes cp on cp.code = s.code join latest_candidate_capture c on c.captured_at = s.captured_at where s.deleted_at is null and s.last_price > 0 and (s.change_pct is null or s.change_pct > -99.99) order by s.code ), source_mapping as ( select tdx_code6 from ths_mapping where ths_code = #{industryCode} ), candidates as ( select related.ths_code, related.ths_name, related.confidence, related.tdx_code6 from ths_mapping related join source_mapping source on source.tdx_code6 = related.tdx_code6 where related.ths_code <> #{industryCode} ), target_stats as ( select candidates.ths_code, candidates.ths_name, candidates.confidence, count(distinct latest.code)::int as target_stock_count, count(*) filter (where latest.change_pct > 0)::int as advancing_count, count(*) filter (where latest.change_pct < 0)::int as declining_count, count(*) filter (where latest.change_pct is null or latest.change_pct = 0)::int as flat_count, round(avg(latest.change_pct), 2) as average_change_pct from candidates join ths_membership membership on membership.ths_code = candidates.ths_code left join latest on latest.code = membership.code group by candidates.ths_code, candidates.ths_name, candidates.confidence having count(distinct latest.code) > 0 ) select target_stats.ths_code as industry_code, target_stats.ths_name as industry_name, 'THS90 + TDX56' as category_label, 0::int as overlap_count, (select count(distinct latest.code)::int from ths_membership source_members join latest on latest.code = source_members.code where source_members.ths_code = #{industryCode}) as source_stock_count, target_stats.target_stock_count, target_stats.advancing_count, target_stats.declining_count, target_stats.flat_count, target_stats.average_change_pct, target_stats.confidence as average_relation_level from target_stats order by target_stats.target_stock_count desc, abs(target_stats.average_change_pct) desc nulls last, target_stats.ths_name limit #{limit}

with ranked as ( select episode_id, stage, confidence_score, coverage_peak, last_evidence_at, row_number() over ( partition by coalesce(sector_code, ''), sector_name, direction order by case when stage in ('confirmed', 'spreading', 'crowded') then 0 else 1 end, confidence_score desc nulls last, coverage_peak desc nulls last, last_evidence_at desc ) as position from market_indicator_sector_episodes where deleted_at is null and trade_date = #{tradeDate} ), selected as materialized ( select episode_id from ranked where position = 1 order by case when stage in ('confirmed', 'spreading', 'crowded') then 0 else 1 end, confidence_score desc nulls last, coverage_peak desc nulls last, last_evidence_at desc limit #{limit} ) select episode.episode_id, episode.trade_date, episode.sector_type, episode.sector_code, episode.sector_name, episode.direction, episode.stage, episode.started_at, episode.confirmed_at, episode.last_evidence_at, episode.eligible_count, episode.observed_count, episode.responded_count, episode.coverage_ratio, episode.coverage_peak, episode.median_lag_seconds, episode.p75_lag_seconds, episode.sector_equal_return_pct, episode.sector_median_return_pct, episode.ex_leader_return_pct, episode.benchmark_excess_pct, episode.breadth_delta_pct_point, episode.confidence_score, episode.confidence_level, episode.data_quality_grade, episode.algorithm_version, episode.payload::text as payload from selected join market_indicator_sector_episodes episode on episode.episode_id = selected.episode_id order by case when episode.stage in ('confirmed', 'spreading', 'crowded') then 0 else 1 end, episode.confidence_score desc nulls last, episode.coverage_peak desc nulls last, episode.last_evidence_at desc

select advice_id, episode_id, target_type, target_code, target_name, position_state, action_class, generated_at, as_of, valid_until, horizon, confidence, disclaimer_code, policy_version, payload::text as payload from market_indicator_trade_reference_advice where deleted_at is null and generated_at::date = #{tradeDate} order by generated_at desc, confidence desc nulls last limit #{limit}

select trade_date, status, minute_bar_count, minute_symbol_count, context_count, indicator_event_count, market_minute_count, industry_minute_count, daily_pool_count, cache_published, quality::text as quality, error_message, built_at from trade_review_day_manifest where trade_date = #{tradeDate}

select trade_date, trade_session, code, name, market, direction, closing_status, is_sealed_at_close, first_touch_at, first_sealed_at, last_sealed_at, last_observed_at, sealed_duration_seconds, open_count, reseal_count, sample_count, valid_sample_count, gap_count, coverage_ratio, max_sealed_amount, avg_sealed_amount, median_sealed_amount, peak_sealed_amount_at, first_sealed_amount, last_sealed_amount, sealed_amount_change, sealed_amount_slope, trend_direction, source, algorithm_version, trend_features::text as trend_features from market_indicator_limit_board_session_summaries where deleted_at is null and trade_date = coalesce(#{tradeDate}, (select max(trade_date) from market_indicator_limit_board_session_summaries where deleted_at is null)) and trade_session = #{tradeSession} and direction = #{direction} order by is_sealed_at_close desc, max_sealed_amount desc nulls last, code limit #{limit}

select trade_date, minute_at, advancing_count, declining_count, flat_count, above_5_count, below_minus_5_count, touched_limit_up_count, sealed_limit_up_count, broken_limit_up_count, sealed_limit_down_count, max_height, seal_rate, break_rate, ladder::text as ladder, source_confidence from trade_review_market_minute_state where trade_date = #{tradeDate} and minute_at <= #{asOf} order by minute_at desc limit 1

select trade_date, advancing_count, declining_count, flat_count, above_5_count, below_minus_5_count, touched_limit_up_count, sealed_limit_up_count, broken_limit_up_count, sealed_limit_down_count, max_height, seal_rate, break_rate, promotion_rate, break_streak_rate, ladder::text as ladder, source::text as source from trade_review_market_daily_state where trade_date = #{tradeDate}

choose.when: select distinct on (membership, industry_code) trade_date, minute_at, membership, industry_code, industry_name, stock_count, advancing_count, declining_count, flat_count, touched_limit_up_count, sealed_limit_up_count, broken_limit_up_count, sealed_limit_down_count, max_height, seal_rate, break_rate, relative_change_pct, ladder::text as ladder, core_pool::text as core_pool from trade_review_industry_minute_state where trade_date = #{tradeDate} and minute_at <= #{asOf} and membership = #{membership} and industry_code = #{industryCode} order by membership, industry_code, minute_at desc
choose.otherwise: select trade_date, membership, industry_code, industry_name, stock_count, advancing_count, declining_count, touched_limit_up_count, sealed_limit_up_count, broken_limit_up_count, sealed_limit_down_count, max_height, seal_rate, break_rate, relative_change_pct, factor::text as factor from trade_review_industry_daily_state where trade_date = #{tradeDate} and membership = #{membership} and industry_code = #{industryCode} order by sealed_limit_up_count desc, relative_change_pct desc nulls last, industry_name

mapper.select: select code, name, event_type, event_at, effective_minute, price, change_pct, limit_up_price, limit_down_price, source, payload::text as payload from trade_review_indicator_event where trade_date = #{tradeDate} and event_at <= #{asOf} order by event_at asc, code asc

select trade_date, scope, membership, industry_code, window_days, phase, phase_score, factor::text as factor, policy_version from trade_review_trend_phase where trade_date = #{tradeDate} and scope = 'market' and membership = 'union' and window_days = #{windowDays} order by updated_at desc limit 1
